name: tong-prompt
title_zh: 作者原意不动，锁一个三秒可认的画面锚点再落笔
tagline_zh: 你说想法，它不换你的画面。只问一个岔路口，锁住三秒可认的锚点，产出即梦/可灵/MJ 能直接贴的提示词。
tagline_en: You describe the idea, it keeps your intended look. Asks one fork, locks a recognizable anchor, outputs.
desc_en: Turn an author's idea into a model-ready image or video prompt without swapping their intended look. Lock a 3-second recognizability anchor, ask at most one missing fork, paste a ready-to-copy prompt, then scan plastic style-stacks. Use when the user asks 提示词, 出图prompt, 即梦提示词, Midjourney, 可灵, 视频提示词, 把想法写成提示词, or tong-prompt. Does not call image or video APIs.
why_zh: 它把「作者意图」当约束而非素材：先锁锚点再补细节，避免提示词常见的跑味和风格堆砌。只问一个岔路。
why_en: Treats author intent as a constraint, not raw material: anchor first, details later. Prevents drift and style-cliché. Asks only.
limit_zh: 只产出文本提示词，不调图像/视频 API。需要你已有明确画面意图；若想法模糊到连一个关键岔路都答不出，它会停下追问。
limit_en: Text prompts only; no image/video API calls. Needs a clear visual intent; if too vague to answer one fork, it stops and asks—won't invent for you.
title_en: Keep the author's look, lock a 3-sec anchor, then write.
